data.camera: medium shot, reviewing government petitions at royal desk
data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 王座理政】王座厅的政务桌前，希斯特里亚披着浅色大衣低头批阅文件，金色长发挽起，眉间带着超越年龄的沉稳——「王的职责，就是让墙内的人能好好活下去。」
data.promptProse: Historia reviews government petitions at the throne hall's desk, blonde hair pinned up above a pale coat, white shirt and trousers. Her brow stays calmly concentrated in the medium view, with papers arranged near her working hands and the throne rising farther behind. Hall daylight illuminates the page she reads and the coat collar, leaving fine stacked-paper shadows and darker carved recesses beyond the desk.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 王座理政
